title: armeria pseudarmeria subsp. davaei
intro: Armeria pseudarmeria subsp. davaei, commonly known as Davaei Sea Thrift, is a plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Armeria pseudarmeria subsp. davaei are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve coughs, and clear mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
